messages.subject: International Executive Candidate | Director-Level Leadership
messages.body:
Dear NovaStaff Global Team,

I am contacting you through your current recruitment address following an earlier delivery failure. I serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with senior experience across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, stakeholder management, compliance and cross-functional operations.

I am internationally mobile and interested in senior professional and leadership opportunities across the UK, Europe, GCC and other international markets. My target areas include sustainability, external affairs, government relations, strategic partnerships, country operations and business development.

My executive CV is attached. I would appreciate being considered for relevant professional or management-level opportunities within your network.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
